summary.business_type: Local service business (hybrid brick-and-mortar / service-area) — luxury catering, Delhi NCR
summary.data_limitations: No Google, Moz, Bing or DataForSEO credentials configured. No field data: no CrUX, no Search Console, no GA4, no DA/PA. All performance figures are lab-measured against the live site or derived from source.
top_findings: Two deploy paths exist and production runs the Express app, not the dist/ static build — so four correct, committed SEO fixes never reach users
Live /sitemap.xml stamps all 38 URLs with today's date on every request, the exact anti-pattern scripts/build.js was written to avoid
Person schema on /about references /team/aarti-sharma, which returns HTTP 404
Zero application-set security headers across 60+ live requests
Page-type mismatch: the highest-volume commercial queries reward listicles and directories, a format the site has nowhere
quick_wins: Port honest lastmod logic from scripts/build.js:160-185 into routes/pages.js:20-31
Fix or remove the Person @id pointing at the 404 /team/aarti-sharma
Add maxAge to express.static() in server.js:23 — CSS, JS, fonts and WebP have no Cache-Control
Fix the anchor text reading 'best caterers in Delhi' that points at the Noida URL
Retarget /blog/wedding-catering-menu-in-delhi at 'indian wedding menu list' (1600 volume, difficulty 3) — right page type, wrong phrase
Trim 22 titles over 60 characters and 11 meta descriptions over 160
Ask ANI to link the website instead of Instagram — converts a live press feature into real link equity

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: No thin content anywhere — word counts 310 to 2515, median 1097
Location pages are genuinely differentiated, not templated: 45 pairs measured, max 5-gram Jaccard 0.207, median 0.076, zero pairs above 0.30
Genuinely first-hand brand case studies with real specifics (Lamborghini, Tesla, Ferrari, BMW, Bath & Body Works)
Named founders with LinkedIn and consolidated Person schema
Source comments document real editorial discipline including anti-fabrication rules

findings.title: Four pages carry a first-person expertise byline over third-party copy
findings.description: About 9,100 words across four pages carry a 'Pallav Goel, Co-Founder' byline while source comments at utils/content.js:1427-1431 state the copy was supplied and published verbatim. Those pages also state unverified facts about named competitors (utils/content.js:1705), against the site's own verification rule at :1805-1809.
findings.recommendation: Appears to be a deliberate editorial decision, so the call is the owner's. Lowest-cost mitigation is a provenance line on those four pages rather than a rewrite.

findings.title: Two location pages are generic template copy with broken grammar
findings.description: best-catering-services-in-noida and corporate-catering-services-in-noida, e.g. utils/content.js:2076-2078: 'If so, we can cater to your corporate catering services in Noida.' The other four location pages are strong.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite to the standard the other four already set.

findings.title: Testimonials are unverifiable
findings.description: Four generic quotes reused site-wide with no date, photo or source. One is attributed to a Udaipur wedding while appearing on Noida and Delhi pages.
findings.recommendation: Collect real attributed reviews, which would also unlock legitimate Review schema.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: All 38 URLs return 200 with correct self-referencing canonicals
Route table and sitemap both derive from one registry in utils/pageMeta.js, making page/sitemap drift structurally impossible
Genuinely server-rendered — every SEO element present with zero JavaScript execution
Legacy WordPress redirects verified working end-to-end including a nested path and a legacy PDF
404 handling returns a real 404, not a soft 200

findings.title: Live sitemap stamps every URL with today's date on every request
findings.description: Verified live: all 38 URLs carry <lastmod>2026-08-14</lastmod>. dist/sitemap.xml has 12 distinct real dates plus 204 image entries. routes/pages.js:20-31 causes this; scripts/build.js:166-169 carries a comment explaining exactly why it is harmful.
findings.recommendation: Port the build.js lastmod logic into the Express route.

findings.title: No application-set security headers
findings.description: Across 60+ live requests: HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are all absent. The only header present, Content-Security-Policy: upgrade-insecure-requests, is platform-injected and missing on roughly 40-60% of requests due to CDN edge variance.
findings.recommendation: Add helmet to server.js, or set the headers manually.

findings.title: Static assets have no Cache-Control
findings.description: Verified live: CSS, JS, fonts and WebP receive no Cache-Control. Only JPEG gets a 1-year lifetime, and that comes from the CDN. server.js:23 calls express.static() with no maxAge; the real caching scheme lives only in dist/.htaccess, which nothing on the live path reads.
findings.recommendation: Set { maxAge: '1y', immutable: true } on express.static().

findings.title: URL variants return 200 instead of redirecting
findings.description: /about/, /ABOUT and /about?utm_source=test all serve 200. /about and /about/ are byte-identical. Mitigated because all variants emit a correct canonical to the clean URL.
findings.recommendation: 301 the variants. Robustness, not an active duplication problem.

findings.title: Two-hop redirect on bare-HTTP apex
findings.description: http://virtuosocatering.com goes to https://virtuosocatering.com then to https://www.virtuosocatering.com.
findings.recommendation: Collapse to a single hop.

findings.title: IndexNow not implemented
findings.description: No key file, no code. Feeds the Bing index that Copilot cites from.
findings.recommendation: Implement — it is free.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: 38/38 URLs at HTTP 200
Zero missing titles, zero duplicate titles
Zero missing meta descriptions, zero duplicates
Zero pages with missing or multiple H1
Zero missing canonicals, zero self-reference mismatches
Zero missing og:title, og:description or og:image

findings.title: 22 of 38 titles exceed 60 characters
findings.description: Worst: 89 chars on /blog/best-wedding-caterers-hospitality-before-food. Pattern is a long descriptive title plus ' | Virtuoso Catering House'.
findings.recommendation: Trim to under 60. Mechanical, no downside.

findings.title: 11 of 38 meta descriptions exceed 160 characters
findings.description: Topping out at 301 characters on /blog/food-trends-delhi-ncr-weddings-2026.
findings.recommendation: Trim to under 160.

findings.title: Title and H1 cannibalisation on two pages
findings.description: /wedding-caterers-in-delhi and /best-wedding-caterers-in-delhi-what-sets-them-apart carry near-duplicate titles and H1s for the same query while running different schema. Found independently by two specialists. Body copy is genuinely distinct (measured max similarity 0.207), so this is a targeting collision, not duplicate content.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate the target query onto one page, or re-title the second.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Zero JSON-LD parse errors across all 38 pages
BreadcrumbList on 37/38 pages, home correctly excluded
BlogPosting on all 22 article-template pages
Press schema deliberately limited to only the two verified mentions
Correctly no aggregateRating — no legitimate rating data exists to source one from

findings.title: Person @id references a URL that returns 404
findings.description: /about emits schema referencing https://www.virtuosocatering.com/team/aarti-sharma. Verified live: HTTP 404, while /team/pallav-goel returns 200. The team member is defined at utils/content.js:2281 but has no route.
findings.recommendation: Add the route, or point the @id at an /about anchor.

findings.title: Two homepage entity blocks are orphaned duplicates
findings.description: views/partials/head.ejs:71-98 emits LocalBusiness + FoodEstablishment with no @id. :100-120 emits Organization with @id .../#organization, repeating the same name and address. Service.provider, BlogPosting.publisher and Person.worksFor all reference the Organization only, leaving the richer node with geo, cuisines and priceRange unreferenceable.
findings.recommendation: Merge behind one @id.

findings.title: areaServed missing from the core LocalBusiness node
findings.description: Declared only on the seven per-page Service sub-blocks, one city each. Directly relevant for a service-area business competing on 'caterers in Delhi' and 'caterers in Noida'.
findings.recommendation: Add areaServed to the main entity.

findings.title: servesCuisine asserts claims no page supports
findings.description: 'Mexican' and 'Bakery' are declared sitewide, including on /privacy-policy and /contact, with no supporting menu content anywhere.
findings.recommendation: Remove the unsupported values.

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: Both Core Web Vitals pass in lab conditions on desktop and throttled mobile
Desktop LCP 1024 ms, CLS 0.001
Mobile LCP 2492 ms, CLS 0.071
TTFB 330 ms
Fonts self-hosted with font-display: swap

findings.title: Third-party analytics is 88-90% of all script weight
findings.description:
gtag.js 165.5 KB plus Meta Pixel 220.7 KB combined is ~386 KB of a ~1 MB page, larger than the entire first-party JavaScript. Most plausible reason mobile LCP resolves to a

rather than the hero image. views/partials/head.ejs:1-31 loads them as the literal first bytes of , ahead of .
findings.recommendation: Move below the meta tags and defer. No data-quality cost for a site converting through an enquiry modal.

findings.title: Mobile LCP passes by an 8 ms margin
findings.description: 2492 ms against a 2500 ms threshold, under lab conditions kinder than a real mid-tier handset on a congested Indian network. Without CrUX the real 75th percentile is unknown.
findings.recommendation: Connect a PageSpeed/CrUX API key to get field data.

findings.title: Italic Cormorant font not preloaded
findings.description: Only 2 of 3 woff2 files are preloaded (head.ejs:67-68). The missing one is used by the preloader's first-paint text.
findings.recommendation: Add the third preload.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: AI crawlers are permitted — robots.txt is a blanket Allow, so GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot and Bingbot are all unblocked
Content is genuinely specific: named venues, real clients, FSSAI references, real pricing tiers
Content specialist scored AI citation readiness at 74/100

findings.title: llms.txt does not exist
findings.description: https://www.virtuosocatering.com/llms.txt returns 404. Additive rather than corrective, since crawlers are already unblocked.
findings.recommendation: Add one.

findings.title: No AI-visibility measurement is configured
findings.description: Citation rates could not be measured at all in this audit. The owner tracks a declining Semrush AI-visibility baseline. Structural readiness is adequate; the gap is measurement.
findings.recommendation: Connect an AI-visibility tool. This is worth more than any structural change recommended blind.

categories.name: Images
what_works: WebP is already served to real browsers via Hostinger CDN content negotiation
The build pipeline generates a .webp sibling for every one of 63 raster images
79 of 154 images use loading=lazy

findings.title: 38 of 154 img tags have no alt attribute
findings.description: An accessibility miss and an image-search miss.
findings.recommendation: Add alt text. Cheap fix.

findings.title: 116 of 154 images have no width/height on the live site
findings.description: dist/ sets them via scripts/html-post.js; the live Express render does not. Measured CLS is nonetheless good (0.001 desktop, 0.071 mobile), so this is robustness rather than an active defect.
findings.recommendation: Port html-post.js logic into the Express layer.

findings.title: CDN WebP transcode is 19% worse than the pre-built files
findings.description: Measured across the ten homepage images: CDN-negotiated 429 KB versus pre-built 345 KB. For the hero specifically, 129,602 bytes versus 103,724. The pre-built files are never referenced because no <picture> element exists on the live site.
findings.recommendation: Wire <picture> into the Express path. Worth about 19% of image bytes, not an emergency.

categories.name: Site Architecture
categories.note: Reported for completeness; folded into Technical SEO for scoring.
what_works: Page/sitemap drift is structurally impossible — both derive from one registry
All 38 URLs confirmed 200
priority and changefreq correctly omitted

findings.title: Three location pages receive zero editorial inbound links
findings.description: /catering-services-in-greater-noida, /corporate-catering-services-in-noida and /wedding-caterers-in-noida get none from the 22 Journal posts, while /wedding-caterers-in-delhi gets 14. The Noida page is the city the business is headquartered in, and 'wedding caterers in noida' currently ranks the homepage rather than the dedicated page.
findings.recommendation: Add editorial internal links to the three starved pages.

findings.title: /contact has no crawlable link from nav or footer
findings.description: Every Inquire control is a JavaScript button with no href. Rescued only by a template fallback anchor on blog posts and two buried body links.
findings.recommendation: Add a real anchor in nav or footer.

findings.title: Internal link with wrong anchor text
findings.description: /best-caterers-in-noida-virtuoso-catering-house closes with a link whose anchor reads 'best caterers in Delhi' but points at the Noida URL.
findings.recommendation: Fix the anchor text.

categories.name: Backlinks
categories.note: INSUFFICIENT DATA. Tier 0 only. DA, PA and spam scores were not measured and are not estimated.
what_works: Domain registered 2024-11-15 with clean history and no expired-domain risk
The codebase enforces an anti-fabrication rule on press claims

findings.title: Both claimed press mentions are live and neither passes link equity
findings.description: Verified independently. The Dailyhunt piece (labelled News18 on-site) contains zero occurrences of the domain. The ANI listicle links the brand name to instagram.com/virtuosocateringhouse rather than the website. Both articles are real and name Virtuoso correctly. The ANI page links all five featured companies to Instagram, so it is house style rather than a slight.
findings.recommendation: Ask ANI to swap or add the website link. Low effort, converts a live feature into real link equity.

findings.title: Press outlet is mislabelled on-site
findings.description: The Dailyhunt page's own JSON-LD gives publisher 'Dailyhunt' and author 'R News India', not News18, which is how it is labelled on the site.
findings.recommendation: Correct the attribution.

categories.name: Search Experience (SXO)
categories.note: Gap score, deliberately not averaged into the health score.
what_works: Sitewide low-friction CTA architecture — Inquire modal, WhatsApp, tel:
/blog/luxury-catering-cost-delhi-ncr is correctly aligned with what ranks for cost queries
/luxury-brand-event-catering-delhi-ncr scores 81/100 for the corporate-buyer persona and cross-links its four matching case studies

findings.title: No listicle-format page exists for listicle-dominated queries
findings.description: 'top 10 caterers in delhi' is 83% third-party listicles and directories. 'best caterers in noida' is 100% — a Medium post and a personal WordPress blog both outrank every brand homepage. Virtuoso has no ranked-comparison page anywhere.
findings.recommendation: Two complementary moves: off-site placement in the directories that own those SERPs, and on-site ranked comparison content. One competitor ranks for 'top 10 caterers in delhi' with a self-published listicle naming itself inside it.

findings.title: No page targets the two highest-volume commercial phrases
findings.description: 'caterers in delhi' and 'catering services in delhi' are 4,400 volume each, and 3 of 7 and 5 of 9 results respectively are exact-match brand homepages — so the format is proven viable. No Virtuoso page targets either phrase.
findings.recommendation: Point /caterers-in-delhi-finding-the-right-fit-for-your-event at the broad phrases.

findings.title: 'luxury caterers in delhi' is unclaimed and highly winnable
findings.description: 7 of 8 results are exact-match brand pages. The SERP wants exactly the asset type the site already has. /luxury-brand-event-catering-delhi-ncr exists but is scoped to corporate activations only.
findings.recommendation: Build or retarget a wedding/general-luxury version using the corporate page's pattern.

findings.title: 'indian wedding menu list' is a near-free win on an existing page
findings.description: 1600 volume at difficulty 3, and 100% of the SERP is dish-list blog guides — several visibly recycling the same generic list. /blog/wedding-catering-menu-in-delhi is already the right page type but targets the wrong phrase. Intent is browsing rather than hiring, and it is a national keyword, so the payoff is topical authority rather than direct leads.
findings.recommendation: Retarget the existing post. Do not target bare 'wedding menu' — that SERP is 100% Western wedding industry.

coverage_gaps: No field data of any kind — no CrUX, Search Console, GA4, Moz or Bing
The GEO specialist did not produce a written report; AI Search Readiness is the least corroborated score
The visual/mobile specialist captured 31 screenshots and a diagnostics file but produced no written analysis
Backlink data is Tier 0 only; Common Crawl referring-domain extraction is a documented no-op, so zero referring domains is a tooling ceiling rather than a finding
Several 'near me' and generic menu queries returned US-biased results and are marked not analysed rather than guessed
